senses.gloss: m. (preced. 2) a soft, spongy substance, hackled wool, rag, lint &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:5">Sabb. VI, 5</cite> <he>מ׳ שבאזנה</he> wool in her ear (to resorb running pus); <he>מ׳ שבסנדלה</he> in her shoes (to soften them). Ib. 134ᵇ <he>מ׳ יבש וכ׳</he> a dry compress or dry sponge.
<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 2:6">Tosef. Nidd. II, 6</cite> <he>משמשות במ׳</he> insert a resorbent (to prevent conception); a. fr.—Pl. <he>מוֹכִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:10">B. Kam. X, 10</cite> <he>מ׳ שהכובס וכ׳</he> the lumps (of threads) which the washer takes out (of the trough).
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 11:12">Tosef. ib. XI, 12</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 11:13">13</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:12">Neg. XI, 12</cite>; a. fr.—[<he>מוּכִּים</he>, <he>מוּכִּין</he>, v. <cite ref="N00809"><he>נָכָה</he></cite>.]
